limitations: Three sequential selected videos, one attempt per video; not a representative success-rate or p95 latency benchmark.
macOS host virtualenv, not the Docker deployment; first NLP model load measured separately.
Fetch includes caption listing, full track retrieval, SRT conversion and optional oEmbed metadata; local transcript cache not used.
Text analysis uses existing whole-text tokenize and vocabulary_features methods in memory; no DB import or LLM calls.
Synthetic profile rescore measures only in-memory weighted counter lookup, not the learner profile, DB access or UI.
Prototype aggregation is not verified for full parity with production exclusions, manual overrides and per-cue lemmatization.
Transcript end time is not video metadata duration; no certified CEFR or listening comprehension measured.
Official YouTube Search API and external paid transcript services were not called; expected key names were absent.
